description: Source code implementing IPv4 and IPv6 configuration and management functions for network interfaces, including setting, clearing, enabling, disabling, and logical layering of network references.

methods.name: get_addressing_v4_type
methods.description: Converts mode_ctrl to a string representing IPv4 addressing type based on mode flags.

methods.name: get_routing_v4_origin
methods.description: Converts mode_ctrl to a string representing IPv4 routing origin based on mode flags.

methods.name: ipv4_set_config
methods.description: Configures IPv4 on a network interface based on mode and parameters.

methods.name: ipv4_clear_config
methods.description: Clears IPv4 configuration on a network interface.

methods.name: ipv6_set_config
methods.description: Configures IPv6 on a network interface based on mode and parameters.

methods.name: ipv6_clear_config
methods.description: Clears IPv6 configuration on a network interface.

methods.name: ipv4_layer
methods.description: Sets or clears IPv4 configuration without toggling the interface.

methods.name: ipv6_layer
methods.description: Sets or clears IPv6 configuration without toggling the interface.

methods.name: ip_enable
methods.description: Enables or disables IPv4 or IPv6 interface.

methods.name: logical_layer
methods.description: Adds or removes IPv4/IPv6 references to logical interfaces and configures default routes for IPv4.
